ios.desc:
Send faxes from your iPhone, iPad or Mac without a fax machine. Fax It lets you pay per page with credits, and now you can also add an optional fax number plan when you need to receive faxes.

Pay only for what you use. Send one fax, keep credits for later, or subscribe to a dedicated number while you need inbound faxing.

---

HOW IT WORKS

1. Choose your document — upload from Camera, iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive, Photos, or Messages.
2. Enter the recipient's fax number.
3. Preview your fax before sending.
4. Hit Send. Done.
5. Need to receive faxes? Add an optional Fax It Number plan and receive faxes in your Inbox.

Fax It shows you exactly what the recipient will receive before it goes out. No surprises.

---

WHAT YOU CAN FAX

Send any document as a fax:
- PDFs and images (JPG, PNG)
- Multi-page documents
- Contracts, forms, applications
- Medical records and prescriptions
- Legal documents
- Real estate forms
- Government paperwork

---

FEATURES

- Send to the US, Canada, and supported international destinations
- Optional dedicated US or Canadian fax number for receiving faxes
- Inbox for faxes sent to your number
- Two monthly Fax It Number plans for receive-fax usage
- Multi-page fax support
- Scan documents with your camera
- Adjust image quality and contrast
- Cover page support
- View fax delivery status
- Import from iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox, Camera, Photos, Email, and Messages
- Clean, native design for your Apple devices

---

PRICING

For regular sending, pay per page with credits. Credits never expire, and you can buy as many or as few as you need.

For receiving faxes, add an optional monthly Fax It Number plan with a dedicated US or Canadian number. Number subscriptions are available worldwide through the App Store. You can manage or cancel subscriptions from your Apple Account settings.

---

WHY FAX IT?

Most fax apps force a subscription before you can send anything. Fax It keeps credit-based sending for occasional faxing and adds optional number plans only for people who need a dedicated fax number.

Built by a small team that believes mobile faxing should be simple and honest.

---

DOCUMENTS WE SUPPORT

Import files from:
- iCloud Drive and Files app
- Google Drive
- Dropbox
- Camera (scan directly)
- Photos library
- Email and Messages attachments

---

Got a question or issue? Reach out at faxit@37.technology — we respond!
